claim: does the closed-loop PLL (design/top/top.sch -- VCO + PFD/charge pump + loop filter + divider, issue #28), driven from a cold start (RESETB power-on, with the loop filter's three storage nodes explicitly initialized discharged -- VCTRL = CP = C1's internal node = 0 V, the physical power-on state), lock its output to N * Fref = 25 * 10 MHz = 250 MHz within this manifest's transient window, across the full PVT corner matrix -- the DR-003-ratified sky130 5-corner set (tt/ff/ss/sf/fs x -40/27/125 degC, spec/target-spec.md rows 19/20) crossed with row 1's ratified supply range (1.62/1.80/1.98 V) -- the same grid sim/pll uses, per spec/decision-records/DR-003-corner-and-temperature-scope.md; see this record's own methodology note for that row's ratification status at record time). This supersedes sim/pll's own 200 ns plumbing-only claim as the closed-loop lock measurement issue #52 asks for -- sim/pll itself keeps its narrower plumbing claim (does xschem+ngspice+sky130 run this DUT to completion at all), unedited, per CLAUDE.md's append-only rule.
methodology_note: this testbench's DUT is design/top/top.sch, the real four-block closed-loop PLL (not a throwaway circuit) -- straps NSEL[5:0]=011000 (N=25) and drives REF with a 10 MHz clock and RESETB with a power-on reset pwl, identically to sim/pll/testbench/tb_pll.sch, per sim/pll-lock/testbench/tb_pll_lock.sch's own header comment. `require_lock` is false: a point that completes but never locks is recorded as evidence (no lock within this window, at this corner -- see sim/harness/measure.py's lock criterion), not as a harness failure, because 'the loop does not lock within N microseconds at this corner' is exactly the kind of design fact this campaign exists to surface, and a v1 canary with an undocumented Icp-vs-loop-filter-vs-Kvco coordination gap (see design/top/DESIGN.md's own 'Coordination note') is not assumed to lock going in. A gated pass/fail on lock is a decision for the future ratifying DR once loop bandwidth/lock-time (rows 6/8) are argued from this record. process_corners is the ratified rows 19/20 PVT grid (spec/target-spec.md, DR-003, #77) -- sky130's five standard MOS/BJT process corners including the two mixed-skew corners (sf, fs) that stress this design's un-cascoded PFD/charge-pump UP/DN current mirror -- not a bare local convention, following sim/pll's own tb.json (PR #86); this supersedes the tt/ss/ff-only grid this manifest originally declared (issue #52's first partial increment, PR #57). `measure.ic` forces v(xxxtop.xxvco.ring0)=0 -- the same node/nudge sim/vco/testbench/tb.json already uses for the open-loop VCO campaign -- to break the SPICE exact-device-symmetry degeneracy an odd-stage ring can otherwise sit on indefinitely from an all-identical cold start (a simulator idealization real, mismatched, noisy silicon does not have); `tran_stop` is widened from this manifest's original 3u to 100u to match spec/target-spec.md row 8's own DRAFT <100us lock-time budget, and `timeout_s` raised from 1800 to 10800 to accommodate the larger per-point wall-clock cost that window requires. See spec/decision-records/DR-004-pll-lock-cold-start-nudge-and-window.md for the full evidentiary justification (why the nudge is representative of real silicon rather than papering over a genuine defect) and design/top/DESIGN.md's 'Known gap: closed-loop cold-start convergence (issue #98)' section for the diagnostics that motivated it. `measure.ic` additionally forces the loop filter's three storage nodes discharged -- v(xxxtop.vctrl)=0, v(xxxtop.cp)=0 and v(xxxtop.xxlf.z1)=0 (C1's internal node, see design/loop-filter/loop_filter.sch) -- because a `tran` card without `uic` starts from ngspice's transient operating point, and for this closed loop that operating point is NOT a cold start: with the ring sitting at its metastable DC equilibrium the divider and PFD are both static, so the charge pump's output node settles wherever the UP/DN leakage balance puts it, which is corner-dependent and frequently near a rail. Measured directly (informal probe, issue #98): with only the ring0 nudge in place the t=0 VCTRL is 1.790 V at sf/125C/1.80V, 1.601 V at ss/27C/1.98V, 0.900 V at ss/-40C/1.80V and 12 uV at tt/27C/1.80V -- i.e. every point started from a different, unphysical initial charge on the loop filter. Adding the three cards above pins t=0 VCTRL to exactly 0 V at every probed corner. See spec/decision-records/DR-005-pll-lock-cold-start-initial-conditions.md. This manifest-default change does not itself constitute a new sim/pll-lock evidence record -- the existing 20260905-193322-0f1934d.md baseline (recorded against the prior 3u/no-nudge defaults) remains the most recent committed full-grid record until a fresh re-run against these new defaults lands (tracked as #103).
